purpose: Freeze the reusable evidence boundary between the existing capitulum pattern-reduction simulation v2 and the developing FDT7 time-axis simulation, without inventing time-history mechanisms that are not yet represented.

legacy_simulation.supported_structural_result: Among the tested toy-generator families, combining module-specific within-taxon variation with heterogeneous pollinator/antagonist regimes is the closest structural match to the frozen target bundle, and this ranking survives five fixed simulation realizations per parameter draw.
legacy_simulation.claim_boundary: This establishes a reusable structural starting point only. It does not show that modular heterogeneity evolved through time, that repeated trait transitions are adaptive, or that ecological events caused transitions.

time_axis_seed.orientation_minimum_changes_boundary: Topology-robust lower bound; not an adaptive-convergence count.

reuse_now: coupled versus modular within-taxon variation contrast

model_aliases.reason: The repository does not yet contain a frozen definition of the M0/M3/M4/M5 labels. Do not assign aliases by inference. M5 is nevertheless operationally blocked because ecological-opportunity pulse tests require a dated tree.
